title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 8: NFL's two best divisions going in opposite directions?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 8: NFL's two best divisions going in opposite directions?
sources.description: The NFC North is the NFL's best division, the AFC North not far behind. The Vikings' defeat and loss of Lamar Jackson changed the complexion of both.
